narratives.headline: Seven-game Sunday, five Pass-grade unders, and the injury reports still to come
narratives.briefing: It is a 7-game Sunday with every game still to tip and no prop clearing the Pass grade: the five picks carry conviction between 30 and 38, so treat this as a thin board. The edge, such as it is, sits in rebound and assist unders where the simulation is well ahead of DraftKings, most clearly Josh Giddey at 72% in sims against a 50% market price. Every card is already past its play-to, so the opening prices are gone and patience at the listed numbers matters more than chasing. The record argues for caution: the morning report is 7-12-0 (-5.78u) and game lines are 17-36 (-20.74u) since 2026-11-11, although morning picks have seen the closing line move toward them 12 times and against them 6. This edition is written before injury reports are final; we are waiting on Norman Powell and Jalen Smith for Chicago, Kingston Flemings for Atlanta and Cade Cunningham for Detroit, and any change there re-prices the cards on the next run.

cards.p|4871145|reb|Under: The simulation has Giddey under 6.5 in 72% of games with a 5.4 average, the projection is 5, and DEN is #8 toughest of 30 on point guard rebounds. What makes us wrong is Caleb Wilson being out: his usage jumps 17% to 22% without him, and the overs came when he played long, 31.5 minutes against a 23.8 projection tonight.
cards.p|4711294|reb|Under: Buzelis has stayed under 5.5 in 8 of his last 10 and the sim lands at 4.9, with a 4.5 projection. The risk is a thin margin, with 6 of his last 10 finishing within 1 of the number, plus a +30% bump without Wilson; at −130 there is little room for a bad bounce.
cards.p|4869342|ast|Under: DET is #1 toughest of 30 on point guard assists and the sim has Daniels under in 60% of games, helped by a 40% blowout rate. Against it: he is averaging 6.5 assists over his last 10, the projection of 5.6 sits above the line, and the market has out-predicted the model on assists this season (83-113 when that reason argued against), so this one leans heavily on the price.
cards.p|4431680|reb|Under: The projection of 6.6 is under 7.5 and his history against DET is 2.8 rebounds a game in 4 meetings, but the sim is only 50% and he has gone under 7.5 just 3 of his last 10 while averaging 9. This is the weakest-supported card on the board; Flemings's status matters for how Atlanta's minutes shake out.
cards.p|5160992|reb|Under: The projection of 5.1 and a 61% sim rate support the under, and his recent trend is improving. The worry is that he is averaging 7.4 over his last 10 and only 3 of those went under; if his minutes run long, as in the overs at 27.8, the number is in danger.

narratives.leans_note: The five game-line leans, led by DAL -1.5 at 57% in sims against 51% at DraftKings, are leans only; game lines are 17-36 since 2026-11-11 and nothing here is a best bet.

narratives.headline: Four of five morning picks are gone; the midday board is five Pass-grade rebound unders, with two past their play-to
narratives.briefing: The board turned over since the morning edition: Josh Giddey, Dyson Daniels, Onyeka Okongwu and Alex Sarr were all removed as no longer +EV, and only Matas Buzelis survives, back on at −110 after being pulled twice. The new cards are Klay Thompson Under 2.5, Cooper Flagg Under 6.5, Ivica Zubac Under 8.5 and Daniel Gafford Under 6.5, all rebound unders and all graded Pass (conviction 37 to 41), so this is still a thin slate rather than a strong one. The market has been moving against us: Gafford drifted to −128, past his −126 play-to, Buzelis at −110 sits past his −107 play-to, Zubac at −122 is a tick past −121, and Josh Hart, Naji Marshall, Bam Adebayo and Neemias Queta all came and went during the day. The record calls for caution: morning picks are 9-15-0 (-6.96u), finals 10-15-0 (-6.82u), and game lines 17-36 (-20.74u) since 2026-11-11, though the closing line has moved toward morning picks 15 times and against them 7. Before tip we are waiting on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Giannis Antetokounmpo for OKC @ MIA, Karl-Anthony Towns and Pascal Siakam for IND @ NY, and P.J. Washington (now doubtful) for DAL @ UTAH; any change re-prices the cards on the next run.

cards.p|6475|reb|Under: The strongest-supported card on the board: he goes under in 89% of 10,000 sims, the projection is 1.1 against 2.5, and he stayed under 2.5 in 9 of his last 10. What makes us wrong is the price and the opponent: at −175 it has to win 64% of the time to break even, he went under 2.5 in only 1 of 6 against OKC, and the overs came when he played long (29.3 minutes against a 21.7 projection tonight). The play-to is −176, so there is almost no room left.
cards.p|5041939|reb|Under: Added this afternoon and now at +113, just better than its +112 play-to: the sim has him under in 70% of games with a 5.5 average and the projection is 5.8. The case against is real: you are betting against DraftKings, which prices this at 44%, he averaged 9.0 rebounds in 3 games against UTAH, and UTAH games have +4% rebounds up for grabs. P.J. Washington moving to doubtful is the status to watch.
cards.p|4017837|reb|Under: The model projects 5.5 against 8.5 on a short 18.9-minute projection, the sim is 82% under, and NY games have -8% rebounds up for grabs. It was downgraded to conviction 39 and −122 is one tick past the −121 play-to, so this is not a number to add at; he also went under 8.5 in only 2 of 6 against NY and averaged 9.8 rebounds in 4 games against them. A change for Karl-Anthony Towns or Pascal Siakam would re-price it.
cards.p|4278049|reb|Under: The sim (71%), the projection (5.7) and recent form (under 6.5 in 8 of his last 10) all point under. But the price has run to −128, past the −126 play-to, so the brief's own instruction is not to add here; and without P.J. Washington he has gone under 6.5 in only 5 of 14, which matters with Washington now doubtful.
cards.p|4711294|reb|Under: The only morning pick still standing: the sim has him under in 62% of games and he stayed under 5.5 in 8 of his last 10. It is a thin one, with 6 of his last 10 finishing within 1 of the number, +2.8 minutes with Norman Powell out and a +30% bump without Caleb Wilson; at −110 it is past the −107 play-to.

narratives.leans_note: Game lines remain leans only at 17-36 (-20.74u); the biggest sim gap left is DEN @ CHI Under 235.5 at 60% in sims against 50% at DraftKings, and OKC +4.5 is new since the morning.
